credits.title: Teen Muhurat
credits.overview: Teen Mahurat is a film with three different segments that deal with women empowerment and revolve around three women who take an important decision of their life in three auspicious hours.

credits.title: Nayyi Navelli
credits.overview: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

credits.title: Phoolan
credits.overview: Follows an impoverished 17-year-old girl who becomes a famous outlaw and survives a brutal 48-hour siege when thousands of armed men trap her in a village.

credits.title: Elaichi
credits.overview: On their wedding night, a groom's excitement and a bride’s haunted past collide in this tender, humorous tale of second chances and societal expectations.

credits.title: Hanji Kaun
credits.overview: Three friends move into a new flat, only to find dead bodies, weird visitors, and nonstop chaos! Mystery meets comedy in this mad, wild ride!

credits.title: Ghamasaan
credits.overview: Set in the Hindi heartland, the story follows a cat and mouse chase against a ruthless dacoit. An honest IPS officer is determined to hunt him down, corrupt politicians notwithstanding.

credits.title: Vedaa
credits.overview: A court-marshalled soldier with a traumatic past helps a young girl from 'lower' caste and an aspiring boxer work towards her dreams despite her hostile environment.

credits.title: Samanantar
credits.overview: In Hindi and Sanskrit language 'SAMANANTAR' means the parallel, and that's what this film is all about, how does the unknown force of the parallel realm start manifesting once humans breach all the limits through their evil actions. A philosophical-cum-horror 'anthology' of four hard-hitting stories entangled together
